design: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: JRPG tactical pixel-art mounted BOW KNIGHT class model sheet, stronger promotion of the archer and sniper. First reference is our accepted archer's simple blue/ivory style and matte material palette. Second reference supplies the native mounted silhouette and upright bow placement, not its purple palette. Design four COMPLETE mounted character views in a 2x2 grid: top-left facing LEFT three-quarter; top-right REAR straight away; bottom-left FRONTAL straight toward viewer with two visible eyes; bottom-right facing RIGHT three-quarter. Same rider and white horse in all four views. Rider has short pure dark navy hair, visible natural peach face and eyes, a solid ivory open-faced brow guard, broad ivory shoulder and chest armor, blue short tunic with clean ivory borders, navy boots, brown belt and large back quiver. White muscular warhorse with navy mane and tail, brown bridle/saddle, simple blue and ivory caparison and ivory chest guard. Horse armor remains flexible and does not obscure the four articulated legs. Rider is seated anatomically on saddle, legs continuous with hips. Oversized ivory recurved GREATBOW with thick limbs and brown grip, noticeably larger/heavier than a sniper's normal longbow, thin dark string. Bow upright in the bow hand; no sword, spear, shield, crossbow or gun. Use only SIX flat material colors: navy #172638, blue #3976b5, warm ivory #e4e1c8, skin #dda77d, wood/leather brown #8c6b45, restrained cool shadow #889cab. More ivory, little gray; soft moderately saturated blue; pure single-color hair, no specular or fabric highlights, no gradients. Clean square pixel blocks like the reference, consistent contour weight, readable unbroken silhouette, no texture noise. Full bow tips, horse ears, tail and every hoof inside the canvas with generous margins. Transparent background, no ground shadows, no labels or text.

Only horse legs flex, very tiny arm/bow articulation. IMPORTANT native map stance: tall upright bow is on IMAGE RIGHT of rider, behind the rider/horse neck (not to the front image-left). Rider looks LEFT and carries bow upright behind his body, no aiming or shooting in these poses. Leave wide gaps between all three complete figures. Native 0,1,2 respectively.
